title: Studying and homework
text: Quiet, steady music helps you concentrate while reading, doing homework or revising for an exam in the library. Pick low-energy lofi beats with no sudden changes.
keywords: study studying homework exam reading library concentrate revise

title: Coding and deep work
text: For programming and deep work, choose mellow lofi with a calm groove that fades into the background so you stay in flow.
keywords: coding programming code developer deep work office laptop

title: Workout and gym
text: Lifting, cardio and running need high-energy tracks with a driving beat to keep your intensity up.
keywords: gym workout exercise run running lifting cardio pump training

title: Party and dancing
text: Parties, clubs and festivals call for euphoric, very high-energy dance music with big drops.
keywords: party dance dancing club festival celebrate celebration rave

title: Sleep and wind down
text: To fall asleep, meditate or wind down, choose very quiet, slow, spacious ambient music.
keywords: sleep sleeping bedtime wind down meditate meditation relax unwind

title: Rainy day reflection
text: Grey, rainy days suit slow, melancholy, reflective pieces, often piano or classical.
keywords: rain rainy gloomy melancholy reflective grey cloudy thoughtful

title: Sad or heartbroken
text: When you feel sad, lonely or heartbroken after a breakup, blues and slow soulful songs let you sit with the feeling.
keywords: sad breakup heartbreak heartbroken cry crying lonely blue down

title: Driving and commuting
text: Night drives, road trips and commutes pair well with moody synthwave at a steady mid-to-high tempo.
keywords: drive driving road trip commute night car highway

title: Date night and romance

title: Happy morning
